### Attachments signed with the record

- `clerk-thread-summary.md`: The Clerk's summary of the proposal's comment thread (1 comments), in every seat's opening briefing. Comments are cited by the ids in their labels, which is what `ask_clerk` reads back; comment-ids.md resolves each one.
- `clerk-precedents.md`: The Clerk's note on past decisions bearing on this item, in every seat's opening briefing.
- `clerk-reads.md`: Everything a seat had the Clerk read to it during deliberation, in order, as the seat received it.
- `comment-ids.md`: Every comment label cited in this record, by the Clerk or a seat, and the full id of the comment it names. A label is a prefix of the comment's own id, lengthened only where two comments shown shared its first eight hex digits.
- `citation-warnings.md`: Comment citations in this record that name no single comment the Council was shown, found by checking every citation after it was written. Reported, not corrected: the record is what was emitted.
